name: reduce many pair combinations at once by row reduction of a shared matrix
mechanism: instead of reducing one pair combination at a time, select a whole batch of pairs of the same size, write them and everything needed to reduce them as rows of one matrix over the monomials, row-reduce once, and add every new leading term that appears

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Faugère F4 algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Computer algebra: finds a Gröbner basis (also mentions the F5 algorithm)

fails_when: matrices can be huge; many rows reduce to zero (the F5 criterion avoids them)
